#include <vector>

int min_cost(std::vector<int> &numbers)
{
    std::vector<int> costs(numbers.size(), 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < numbers.size(); ++i)
        costs[i] = numbers[i];

        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j)
            costs[j] += std::min(costs[j], costs[j + 1]);
